findings.title: Missing Review Tab in Mobile Bottom Navigation
findings.description: Bottom navigation only has 4 tabs (Today, Plan, Track, Analytics) + center Plus button. The Review tab is missing from mobile navigation but exists in desktop navigation. Users cannot access the spaced review feature on mobile devices.
findings.evidence: Desktop navigation (lines 326-352) includes Review tab with badge showing dueReviewItemsCount. Mobile navigation (lines 707-760) only has Today, Plan, Track, Analytics tabs.
findings.impact: Users cannot access the core spaced review feature (with due items needing attention) on mobile devices. Feature parity broken between desktop and mobile.
findings.correction: Add a 5th tab button for Review after Analytics in bottom navigation (around line 760). Should use RotateCw icon, text-primary when active, text-gray-400 when inactive, display badge when dueReviewItemsCount > 0, onClick setCurrentTab('review'), aria-label='Review', and min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px] touch target.
